title: AION 2 Map: Interactive Tools and Resources
description: Choose AION 2 interactive maps, find gathering nodes and exploration collectibles, use in-game filters, and solve cave, height and progress problems.
summary: Choose your faction and zone, filter one objective at a time and check height when a marker seems missing. Build a compact route and track completed stops.
quickAnswer: Use Aion2T to filter resource markers and Aion2Maps when height or cave entrances matter. Select your faction’s zone first: Verteron for Elyos or Altgard for Asmodians, and compare community markers with your current in-game map.

workflow.title: Build a compact resource route
workflow.caption: Filter one material, plan the terrain access and record completed stops.

steps.label: Match faction and zone
steps.description: Use the zone displayed by your character, then choose the same zone in the tool.

steps.label: Show one resource
steps.description: Hide unrelated layers and select only the material needed by your recipe.

steps.label: Check access and height
steps.description: Compare landmarks, paths and cave entrances before ordering nearby stops.

steps.label: Test and record
steps.description: Run the compact loop once; note missing nodes, yield and completion before repeating.
